name: Cambridge University Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust
site: Addenbrooke's Hospital. NOTE: the published Type 1 figure INCLUDES the on-site paediatric ED (ECDS Paediatric Performance sheet shows 2,420 T1&2 paediatric attendances) - confirm the CHEQS footprint matches.
status: MIXED BUILD - headline volumes, validation targets, paediatric and MH shares are REAL, transcribed from the primary publication files committed under data/ (each block cites file + sheet/column). Distribution blocks (hourly shape, acuity mix, ambulance share, admission-by-acuity) remain SYNTHETIC placeholders until the CUH CHEQS extracts land - each says so in its source.

attendances_per_day.source: NHS England monthly A&E Attendances and Emergency Admissions, June 2026 provider CSV (data/June-2026-CSV-Wfg38l.csv), row RGT: 'A&E attendances Type 1' = 12,015 / 30. All-types incl. 'Other A&E Department' (5,849) would be 595/day - the model's footprint is the Type 1 ED. https://www.england.nhs.uk/statistics/statistical-work-areas/ae-waiting-times-and-activity/

four_hour_pct.note: VALIDATION TARGET (not a model input). Corroborated by ECDS provisional 4 Hour Performance: 53.58% T1&2 (5,700 of 12,280 over 4h).
four_hour_pct.source: data/June-2026-CSV-Wfg38l.csv row RGT: 1 - (5,656 over-4hrs Type 1 / 12,015 Type 1 attendances). ECDS corroboration: data/ECDS_Performance_Provisional_Jun_26_2026-07-03_091942_VZF6MT.xlsx, '4 Hour Performance', row RGT.

twelve_hour_pct.note: VALIDATION TARGET. DTA-based (matches the model's 12-hour bed-wait metric): 445 patients waited 12+ hrs from decision-to-admit, / 12,015 Type 1 attendances. The ECDS 12-hours-FROM-ARRIVAL measure is higher: 1,390 of 12,280 T1&2 = 11.32% (all types 7.82%).
twelve_hour_pct.source: data/June-2026-CSV-Wfg38l.csv row RGT ('Patients who have waited 12+ hrs from DTA to admission'); data/ECDS_Performance_Provisional_Jun_26_2026-07-03_091942_VZF6MT.xlsx, '12 Hour Performance', row RGT.

hourly_shares.source: SYNTHETIC PLACEHOLDER (typical NHS Type 1 hour-of-arrival shape) - not in the monthly/ECDS publication files. REPLACE WITH: CHEQS extract 1 (arrivals by hour x mode).

acuity_mix_pct.source: SYNTHETIC PLACEHOLDER (typical national Type 1 acuity mix) - ECDS provisional publishes chief complaint, not acuity, by provider. REPLACE WITH: CHEQS triage-category table.

ambulance_share.source: SYNTHETIC PLACEHOLDER (typical Type 1 conveyance ~30%) - arrival mode is not in the provided publication files. REPLACE WITH: CHEQS extract 1 mode split.

admission_rate_by_acuity.note: Overall check against real data: emergency admissions via A&E Type 1 = 2,822 / 12,015 = 23.5% (June 2026 SitRep); ECDS disposal-admitted 1,955 of 12,280 = 15.9% (different definition).
admission_rate_by_acuity.source: SYNTHETIC PLACEHOLDER per-acuity split. REPLACE WITH: CHEQS extract 3 (area x destination + triage category).

paediatric_share.note: REAL: 2,420 paediatric of 12,280 T1&2 attendances - the published Type 1 footprint INCLUDES the paediatric ED. If the build is scoped adult-only after CUH's answer, set this to 0 and use adult-only denominators from CHEQS.

bed_occupancy.note: REAL. Mirrored in nhs_trust_snapshot.csv as the model INPUT: G&A overnight occupied 952.9 / available 1,067.6.
bed_occupancy.source: NHS England Bed Availability and Occupancy KH03, data/Beds-Open-Overnight-Web_File-Q4-2025-26.xlsx, 'NHS Trust by Sector', row RGT. https://www.england.nhs.uk/statistics/statistical-work-areas/bed-availability-and-occupancy/

inpatient_beds.note: REAL: G&A overnight beds available 1,067.6 (trust total incl. maternity 1,127.1). Mirrored in nhs_trust_snapshot.csv.

ambulance_handover_over_30_min_pct.note: Not in the provided files - real data only (CHEQS extract 8 or winter SitRep).
ambulance_handover_over_30_min_pct.source: NHSE UEC Daily SitRep (winter) / Ambulance Quality Indicators, or CHEQS monthly performance.
